patch_resolves_note: The switched fixed source does add the missing `|| len == 0` guard at `coap_split_uri_sub()`. The stock fixed original is therefore guarded on the saved zero-length `Proxy-Uri` witness, and the adjacent `proxy_uri_len1_slash_boundary` mutation gives the required genuine fixed-side witness by changing only that final option header to length 1 and appending a single `/` byte.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First non-harness project statement that materializes the attacker-controlled UDP packet into the heap-backed PDU buffer and records the post-header extent later re-parsed as options.
Missing empty-input guard. `coap_split_uri_sub()` only rejects null pointers and continues when `len == 0`; the patch adds `|| len == 0` at this exact check.
AddressSanitizer crash site. The first scheme/path probe dereferences the empty `Proxy-Uri` value pointer one byte past the heap-backed PDU body.
Intermediate runtime event proxy_uri_forward materialized from verified transition assertion a_forwarded_proxy_uri_len_reaches_path_probe.

edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `proxy_uri_forward.proxy_uri_len == uri_path_probe.remaining_len == 0`; the fixed `proxy_uri_len1_slash_boundary` witness preserves the same relation at `1 == 1` when the sink genuinely executes.

The vulnerable original trace records `proxy_uri_forward.proxy_uri_ptr == uri_path_probe.probe_ptr`; the fixed `proxy_uri_len1_slash_boundary` witness preserves the same pointer handoff when the sink genuinely executes.
